text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeahhh! I did it—I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka has a good run in the junior G1,

overcoming that extremely high hurdle
with sheer
willpower!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is my power! Heck yeah! Hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That was a piece of cake! You'd all
better
remember the name "Vodka!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She waves to the crowd and makes a
cool exit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this definitive race now over, I
decide to
throw a small party to
celebrate this past year.
However...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, I knew it... I'm feelin' a bit groggy
today,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
J-just a little bit, though! I'll be back to
normal in
no time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Stop being so nice. How am I
even
supposed to respond to that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm real worn after that last race. I
managed to
keep up the tough act,
but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Runnin' and lookin' cool in the Twinkle
Series is
wicked tiring.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh. More than you can imagine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's somethin' I set my sights on
myself. I
gotta see it through.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A lot happened in my first year, but I
was able to
do it at my coolest... thanks
to you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thankfully, there were only a handful of
us runnin'
in the junior G1.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it, I can say it was the
perfect
way to get things going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, when I tell her we need to
choose a new
race goal...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hurp... Yikes, that one almost came out. Come on, Trainer, I'm too full to be talkin' about what's next.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But, if we gotta... The first thing that
comes to
mind for next year's goal is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sure, but hold off on that for now. That's
my big
goal. First...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are two tours in the Classics: The
Triple
Crown tour and the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is the second race in the
Triple Crown.
Before that, it's normal to
run in the Satsuki Sho,
but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know I've gotta do the Satsuki Sho. But
before
that, I wanna try somethin' a little
easier on the
feet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So pick somethin' that could be a good
steppin'
stone for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A good way to prepare for the Satsuki
Sho would
be running in races like the
Yayoi Sho or the
Spring Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm considering which of them would be
best,
when—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whaaam!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The Tulip Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A certain someone bursts in out of
nowhere with a
suggestion completely
out of left field.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gimme a break. As if I wasn't tired
enough
already, now I gotta deal with
you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I saw you run, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Not that I was watching you or anything
though. I
just happened to see it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Does that distinction really matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Considering it's you we're talking about, I guess that was at least decent for your first G1. However...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show you how it's really
done at the
Classics preliminary—the
Tulip Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You really think you can show me up?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's right. After all, that was just a
fluke.
Desperation is what got you a
half-decent result.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But I'm different from you. I'll show you what it looks like to run with real skill!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: See you there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet whisks herself away as if
riding a
passing storm. My best guess is
she's secretly
jealous of how well Vodka
ran.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get back on topic and ask Vodka
whether she'd
prefer the Yayoi Sho or
the Spring Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm doin' the Tulip Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. Now Vodka is talking nonsense
too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! This is good! If she really
thinks she
can outrun me, then I need to
see it in person!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm far from finished yet! I'll be runnin'
even better
next year!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why? If I run in that, then does it mean I
can't do
the Derby or somethin'?
choice_data_list: 本当に『チューリップ賞』でいいのか？
本当に『チューリップ賞』でいいの？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not necessarily. However, the Tulip Sho
is the
first race in the Tiara Tour and the
qualifying race
for the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that it's an irregular agenda.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just 'cause it's not normal doesn't
make it
an issue. There's no way I'm
backin' down from
Scarlet's challenge.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's decided then! I'm comin' for you,
Tulip!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't care about followin' norms anyway. It's not about where I run, it's about how I run!
